$description: UI motion stays under 300ms. Page motion uses the portfolio's longer steps.

press.$description: Press scale on buttons and chips.

hover.$description: Colour and border changes on hover.

ui.$description: Menus, tooltips, accordion, tab rule. The portfolio --d-1.

overlay.$description: Modals, toasts, sheets entering. Exit at 200ms.

hero.$description: Hero sequences and seamless loops: the Spinner's turn. The portfolio --d-5.

loop-pulse.$description: One breath of a waiting pulse: Skeleton, and the thinking dots.

loop-sweep.$description: One pass of the indeterminate ProgressBar.

loop-blink.$description: The streaming caret, on then off.

loop-calm.$description: The slow pulse that replaces a spin or sweep under reduced motion.

out.$description: Anything entering or responding: menus, toasts, press. The portfolio --e-out.

settle.$description: Things settling into place like paper. The portfolio --e-set.

in-out.$description: Things moving between two places on screen (tab rule, segmented thumb).
